summary.name: 3D Motion Graphics (Digital and 3D Aesthetics; supplemental, user-requested direction). Broad production direction, not one fixed look.
summary.visualIdentity: Genuine 3D rendering, with rendering approach (photorealistic, cartoon, or stylized) chosen before geometry is built. Requires coherent bevels, roughness, reflections, contact shadows, and a clear key light. Perspective or orthographic framing is chosen deliberately. Photorealism and a specific engine are not required.
summary.suitableUses: Explicit: hero renders and object-centred motion where the 3D form carries the message. Hybrid use is advised when strong titling or precise callouts are needed. Inferred: product, collectible, and miniature-scene presentations. Subject, audience, duration, aspect ratio, and resolution are unspecified task inputs.
summary.limitations: Explicit: avoid intersections, floating objects, inconsistent scale, and blown-out highlights. Keep text out of 3D geometry to prevent blowout and aliasing. Bake rigid-body and other simulations before rendering frame sequences. Simulated appearance is not validated physics or photographed production.
summary.palette: Example only, used when no approved palette is supplied. Tokens: background #EDE9E1 (main layout field), foreground #303C40 (text and hierarchy), accent_1 #748E8A and accent_2 #B9866C (subordinate). Foreground on background measures 9.395, meeting the 4.5 normal-text target. Accent pairings (3.239 and 3.624) are decorative only. Gradients are disabled, and supplied exact colors override these tokens.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Video: all state derives from seekable composition time, with no live input. Interactive delivery may bind click, scroll, or hover to bounded progress, with keyboard and reduced-motion equivalents. Cadence should be smooth, but deliberate cuts, impacts, and reading holds are preserved. Catalog references (motion-003, -004, -010, -012, -014, -015, -017, -019, -021) are optional, and each must be screened against actual scene content.
summary.audio: Unspecified by the style; no fixed genre, tempo, instrument, or voice is assigned. Suggest audio from topic, audience, and motion: music, voiceover, effects, ambience, or silence. Honor explicit user requirements first. Use only authorized audio. Verify speech intelligibility, balance, absence of clipping, and picture sync in the final video.
summary.assetRequirements: Authorized 3D models, textures, footage, fonts, and audio must be supplied or created. Exporter metadata does not establish glTF licensing. Preload all assets and fonts before rendering, and dispose owned GPU resources. Add a Meshopt decoder only when an asset requires it. Video textures need frame-accurate synchronization. Exact asset list and dimensions are unspecified.
summary.combinations: Hybrid with style-093: 2D kinetic titles timed to Blender camera beats, suited to product launches and brand stings. Hybrid with style-109: 2D SVG leader lines anchored to exported 3D positions, suited to feature breakdowns. Both suggestions are inferred from the metadata. Each needs matched easing, palette tokens, and no text inside geometry.
summary.productionApproach: Style renderer: Blender with bpy, using Cycles or EEVEE, soft lighting, and material detail; these are suggested routes, not verified installed tools. Motion engine: keyframed Blender motion, with XPBD only for needed deformation (fixed steps, baked state). Pipeline: HyperFrames primary; Remotion only when a verified limitation applies. Chroma.js validates colors. Verify key frames and decoded video before delivery.
